en.topic_title: Woman charged after 136 dogs found without licences at Yuen Long shelter
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong woman has been prosecuted for allegedly keeping 136 dogs without licences at an animal shelter in Yuen Long.



Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department logo. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP.



The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said on Wednesday that it had charged the woman under the city’s Rabies Regulation, which stipulates that all dogs over five months old must hold a valid licence.
